briefdescription.para: Concrete implementation of SpatialTreePatchApplicator for branch nodes.

detaileddescription.para: BranchPatchApplicator manages the application of patches for branch cells in the spatial tree. It handles moisture, resources, obstacles, and habitat domains for cells that have children. It provides mechanisms for applying patches both downwards (to children) and upwards (from children to parent branch).
